title: Northgate Optical Policy on Multiple Eyewear Jobs per Member
content:
**Clause.** A member may hold any number of Northgate Optical eyewear jobs, including several open at the same time for different patients in the household or for different pairs. Each job is priced, billed to insurance, remade and refunded on its own. A charge, credit, remake or guarantee on one job never applies to another job, and no multi-pair discount exists.

There is no limit on the number of eyewear jobs a member may hold.

### What the clause means in practice

| Question about two jobs of the same member | Answer under the clause |
|---|---|
| Is each job priced separately? | Yes, each job carries its own charges. |
| Does a vision plan allowance posted on one job reduce the other? | No; an allowance is a credit on the job it was posted to. |
| Does a remake opened on one pair count against the other pair's guarantees? | No; remakes and guarantees belong to their own job. |
| Is a second pair discounted because a first pair was ordered? | No; there is no multi-pair discount. |

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A member orders Northgate Single Vision Lenses for a child and Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses for themselves on the same day. These are two eyewear jobs. If the progressive pair is later remade, the remake is counted on the progressive job only; the child's job keeps its own remake count, its own guarantees and its own refund position.
